scope: Shared review vocabulary for bird and non-bird source assets; not runtime geometry or acceptance authority.
identity: Keep existing asset_id and variant_id; use a separate candidate_revision for a repair. Original bytes and prior findings remain immutable.

qualification_grades.pass: The explicitly named review scope passed with cited evidence; no broader acceptance is inferred.
qualification_grades.repair: A concrete observed defect needs correction before that scope passes; a versioned repair may be reviewed separately.
qualification_grades.blocked: Required evidence, state, part, tool or authority is missing; absence of proof is not a visual rejection.
qualification_grades.reject: Inspected candidate is unsuitable for the named scope, with an exact reason and retained evidence.

labels.meaning: Visible matte, halo or unwanted alpha fringe at declared display size; fractional alpha alone is not a defect.
Required subject pixels are cut off unintentionally; transparent padding and intentional viewport clipping remain distinct.
Declared raster/world/display sampling produces inconsistent detail or logical pixel size; numerical resampling alone cannot certify style.
Observed anatomy, leaf/branch/flower structure or identifying form conflicts with the named subject; expert certainty remains scoped.
Declared pivot differs from the intended stable visual landmark or changes across states; a valid virtual pivot need not be opaque.
Source-to-world scale, aspect ratio or per-state consistency is missing or wrong; art dimensions are not physical measurements.
An annotation explicitly intended to address visible material instead addresses empty pixels; opaque material alone does not establish physical support.
A visible root, foot, base, mount or seam appears detached or misplaced at the declared display size; not a collision/support approval.
Separately registered parts show a visible unintended gap, halo, overlap or broken join.
Required wood, foliage, subject or background pixels are fused or their ownership is ambiguous; metadata cannot manufacture separate art.
A required healthy/dry/seasonal/weather/action state lacks actual source artwork; slots, reused pixels and labels do not count as new art.
Wind or action parts, attachments, transitions or temporal consistency have not passed their named review; offline motion does not imply runtime physics.
Exact source/admission representation violates a named byte, dimension, frame, alpha or profile rule; identify the tested consumer and version.
Exact source hash, prompt/reference lineage, derivative operation or rights evidence needed for the named scope is missing.
Collision, support, elevation, capacity or calibrated physical dimensions have not been reviewed; visual alpha and paint are not geometry authority.
Functional bird body/foot/beak/water/perch fit or slot behavior remains unreviewed; a point on material is insufficient.
Source candidate has not been deliberately admitted and verified in the actual consumer route; a source merge or preflight does not imply adoption.

evidence_requirements: Cite exact file/hash, region or landmark, native/world/display dimensions and sampling for pixel findings. Record actual operation and test result; unknown tool/model/seed/license fields remain unknown.
stage_rule: generated, reviewed, staged, integrated and accepted are separate facts. A scope pass never changes runtime, physical, rights or owner acceptance.
repair_rule: Never overwrite an original or silently reuse its revision/hash. Preserve before/after bytes, prompts, operation, review result and rejection reason. Do not invent a repair merely to increase repair counts.
compatibility: Consumers map descriptive legacy findings to these labels with explicit scope. New labels require a new contract revision; no claim that the bird producer already adopted this initial version.
